summary: security lens over all-plants-backend (34 product path(s), 6cd492d..995598f, Codex via the autoreview skill at --max-priority P2): 2 blocking, 0 non-blocking. The statement service has a TOCTOU race between pinning the outline batch and querying statement amounts, so a concurrent budget replacement can produce an internally inconsistent financial response. The diff also retains an explicitly forbidden legacy test path. Both are blocking defects under the supplied contracts.

blocking_findings.summary: [P1] Execute statement data against the atomically pinned budget batch (backend/src/mis/mis-statement.service.ts:90): The outline and its batch ID are read first, but each block is then executed independently against whichever budget batch is active at that later instant.

[P1] Remove the retained legacy outline path from the test double (backend/src/mis/mis-statement.service.test.ts:468): `FakeOutlines` still implements the superseded `findByBudgetPeriod` path solely to throw when the service calls it, supported by the `legacyOutlineForbidden` branch and legacy-named fixture option.
